author: AwesomePieMan

scanner.why: ee_exit_struct, ee_radio, ee_song_struct, ee_step_1_switch, ee_step_1_trigs, ee_step_2_crystal_fx look like easter-egg state (map's own, after subtracting 827 stock names); confirm which combination means 'done'

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Map Description Aquatic experiments, deep-sea excavations, swarms of undead scientists. Find the leader to escape and send them back to the abyss! Features – Underwater Base and Environment – Underwater Realism, low gravity and drowning – Excavators from Moon – PES system which prevents drowning – Breachable rooms – Boss Zombie – Huge and complex map layout – Bounce Pads – Black Ops Mod Credits – Tom_Bmx – RDV – UGX Treminaor – YaPh1l – Mrhankey91 – Swazzy – DuaLVII – aokmikey – Hammy der gebissene – Offthewall Beta Testers – P0TZ – TheScotchGuy – RamboBadass – RDV – Nukem – Fatkidslovecake – MrSlagovich – UGX Treminaor – HitmanVere (If we forgot anyone on either list please let us know) Known Issues – In rare cases the moon doors will not change to green when opened, player models in coop will be invisible, hud shaders will not show up, and FX will not play. This seems to be due to a problem with the engine when trying to load files. A simple map restart should fix this. – In semi-rare cases players will spawn with their gun floating in their face. A simple map restart should fix this. – If you get a missing file error restart the map until you load in successfully, this error is due to World at War not being able to load the file. The file does exist.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). The scanner found easter-egg state; WHICH combination means done is a human's call, so the finish is {"manual": true} and the Round 20 fallback applies meanwhile.  DEDI 2026-09-22 (runs map01, map03, map05): boots the map and spawns a server, then dies with `script runtime error: unknown item 'napalmblob'` from `maps/_loadout::init_loadout()` <- `maps/_load::main()` <- `maps/_zombiemode::main()` <- `nazi_zombie_leviathan.gsc:23`, after ~40 `Could not load xanim` lines (ai_flamethrower_*, ai_bonzai_*). Raising the engine's main memory reserve to 422 MB changed nothing and the message is byte-identical across three runs, so this is NOT the asset-limit overflow it was once assumed to be: `napalmblob` is a weapon the map's own precache list asks for and the zones it ships do not contain. Its mod.ff and map fastfile both load, so it is not an fs_game or mount problem. Map-side. DEDI/REFEREE 2026-09-22 (runs mapA/mapB/mapC, join80-join83): THE 'broken' VERDICT IS CONFIRMED AND THE BLAME IS CORRECTED. The previous session left open whether our dedicated server, a referee GSC overlay or the replay sampler was the shared cause. It is none of them, and that was settled by running the maps with ours REMOVED rather than by reading code. dedi.md 14, referee.md 11. NOT re-tested tonight -- the bisect went to the four flag_wait maps and to Der Berg. The existing evidence is map-side on its face: `unknown item 'napalmblob'` is raised from the map's OWN maps/_loadout::init_loadout(), it is a weapon the precache list asks for and the loaded zones do not contain, and the 422 MB reserve did not change it (map03 byte-identical to map01). status stays "broken", and one honest run with maptest.ps1 -NoEnw would settle it the way mapA settled the other four.  ARCHIVE 2026-09-23: THE INSTALL IS COMPLETE -- nothing is missing from our extraction. 7-Zip's listing of nazi_zombie_leviathan_v1.2.exe shows EIGHT entries, three of them $PLUGINSDIR, and the five that matter (missingasset.csv, mod.arena, mod.ff, nazi_zombie_leviathan.ff, nazi_zombie_leviathan.iwd) are byte-for-byte what we installed. This release ships NO <bsp>_patch.ff and NO <bsp>_load.ff, which every other release in the set does, so the engine loads `default` in its place. weapons/sp/napalmblob DOES exist in the stock game (main\iw_14.iwd) and the string appears inside the generic 690,464-byte custom-map patch fastfile that Zombie Desert and Clinic of Evil ship byte-identically. Supplying that file under the name nazi_zombie_leviathan_patch.ff made the engine load it and did NOT fix `unknown item 'napalmblob'` (run addon6). The weapon is referenced but not registered as a weapondef by that zone. status stays "broken". dedi.md 15.
dedi_verdict_source: dedi.md 14; runs mapA (stock exe, listen server) and mapB (ENW_NO_SAMPLERS=1)

add.reason: The release ships FIVE files (missingasset.csv, mod.arena, mod.ff, nazi_zombie_leviathan.ff, nazi_zombie_leviathan.iwd) and no <bsp>_patch.ff -- verified against the NSIS installer's own file table, so nothing was lost in extraction. The engine therefore falls back to `Loading fastfile 'default'` (map03 console line 2189) and `PrecacheItem("napalmblob")` at maps/_loadout.gsc:34 fails with `unknown item 'napalmblob'`. weapons/sp/napalmblob DOES exist in the stock game (main\iw_14.iwd) and IS inside the generic 690,464-byte custom-map patch fastfile that Zombie Desert and Clinic of Evil both ship BYTE-IDENTICALLY (sha256 d3eedd1e...): the string `napalmblob` is at offset 58521 of its inflated 2,348,417 bytes. So this adds a file the archive already holds, under the name the engine looks for.
add.result: RUN addon6: the file was staged in and the engine DID load it (`Loading fastfile 'nazi_zombie_leviathan_patch'` at console line 2197, where run map03 had fallen back to `Loading fastfile 'default'`). `unknown item 'napalmblob'` at maps/_loadout.gsc:34 is UNCHANGED. The missing patch fastfile is real and is now a named fact about this release, but it is not what breaks the map. Not applied.
